fullDesc: On June 26, 2015 the Supreme Court ruled 5 to 4 in Obergefell v. Hodges that same-sex couples have a constitutional right to marry. The ruling made same-sex marriage legal in all 50 states.
realFacts: Justice Anthony Kennedy wrote the majority opinion
Jim Obergefell had sued to be named on his husband's death certificate
Public support for the change had grown for years
Gay marriage was already legal in a number of countries
